newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: DALZIEL DROPPED FROM HEALTH ROLE BY NZ'S LABOUR.
newsitem.headline: DALZIEL DROPPED FROM HEALTH ROLE BY NZ'S LABOUR.

text.p: Labour's Lianne Dalziel, tipped by political pundits as a future Labour Party leader, has been dropped from her role as health spokeswoman, parliamentary sources said on Friday.
Her job has been taken by Annette King.
The move is seen as a demotion for Dalziel who has failed to perform up to reputation, political commentators said.
Labour leader Helen Clark is due to make an announcement this afternoon on the reshuffle of the front bench roles.
